_readme: Source for the three tutorial Huedokus (Sudoku in colours; each number is a colour). Edit here, then run `npm run tutorials` to rebuild public/tutorials/huedoku/huedoku-*.json. Grid rows use . for an empty square. `box` is a box's width and height in squares. The build (shared with Sudoku, tutorials/sudoku/sudoku.js) checks every grid has exactly one solution. `"teaches": "onlyPlace"` also makes the build check the grid has squares that are the only place in their box for a number but could take others, and that it finishes with just those and one-number-left squares.
